record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: Can one choose complex numbers a1, a2, c1, and c2, together with an entire function F(z1,z2), so that F(z1,z2) has bounded L-index in a fixed direction b = (b1,b2), but the affine coordinate change G(z1,z2) = F(a1 z1 + c1, a2 z2 + c2) has unbounded L-index in that same direction b = (b1,b2)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $b=(b_1,b_2)\in\mathbb{C}^2\setminus\{0\}$ be a fixed direction and let $L:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{R}_+$ be a fixed positive continuous function. For an entire function $F:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}$, define the directional derivatives along $b$ by
$$\partial_b^0 F(z)=F(z),\qquad \partial_b^k F(z)=\frac{\partial^k}{\partial t^k}F(z+tb)\Big|_{t=0}\quad(k\ge 1),\ z\in\mathbb{C}^2.$$
The function $F$ is said to have bounded $L$-index in the direction $b$ if there exists a nonnegative integer $N$ such that for every $z\in\mathbb{C}^2$ and every nonnegative integer $k$,
$$\frac{|\partial_b^k F(z)|}{k!\,L(z)^k}\le \max_{0\le j\le N}\frac{|\partial_b^j F(z)|}{j!\,L(z)^j}.$$
The least such $N$ is the $L$-index of $F$ in direction $b$; if no such $N$ exists, $F$ is said to have unbounded $L$-index in direction $b$.

Question: Do there exist complex numbers $a_1,a_2,c_1,c_2\in\mathbb{C}$ (with $a_1,a_2\neq 0$) and an entire function $F(z_1,z_2)$ such that $F$ has bounded $L$-index in the direction $b=(b_1,b_2)$, while the entire function
$$G(z_1,z_2)=F(a_1 z_1+c_1,\ a_2 z_2+c_2)$$
has unbounded $L$-index in the same direction $b$?
artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on bounded L-index in a direction and affine changes of variables return foundational and follow-up works on the theory (criteria, composition with slice functions, behavior under linear changes), but none of the readily available sources explicitly resolve whether an affine substitution $G(z)=F(Az+c)$ (with diagonal $A$) can convert bounded $L$-index in direction $b$ into unbounded $L$-index in direction $b$. The status of this specific problem could not be verified from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Concept of boundedness of L-index in the direction b for slice entire functions is introduced and studied; lists open problems/criteria.
status_evidence.claim: The framework of bounded L-index in a direction is actively developed but the specific affine-substitution question is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Entire functions of several variables of bounded index
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of entire functions of bounded index, including directional notions.
status_evidence.claim: General theory exists; no resolution of the affine change-of-variables question for bounded L-index in a fixed direction is reported.
